part.text:
Fixed `caddyfile.(*lexer).finalizeHeredoc` to use rune indices when locating the heredoc’s last newline, preventing slice bounds panics on non-ASCII input. Also stopped retaining the heredoc body’s trailing newline.

Validated with:

```sh
GOPROXY=off go test ./caddyconfig/caddyfile/ -count=1
```

All package tests pass.
